question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

6, 8, 11, 16, ?, 34, 47, 64
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference between the terms is increasing order of prime numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4957dd7cfd18aaac03d55503d428e19f468ec68c34f482599a34e49894aa1c2e.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
